note.treatmentHint: Which treatment this note is about.
note.signConfirm: Once signed, the note is locked and only addenda can be written. Sign it?
note.addendumHint: The signed text stays as it is; this is added below it with the date and your name.
note.lockHint: A signed note is locked; any later change is a dated addendum.
perio.entryHint: Type a number; the cursor moves on by itself. Click a tooth number to mark it missing.
plan.subtitle: Proposed (alternative), accepted and running plans, priced from the catalog.
plan.noneHint: Select teeth on the chart and add services, or create a new plan.
plan.title: Plan title
plan.templateHint: Its services are added in phases.
plan.acceptHint: This patient's other proposed options can be set aside (cancelled, marked "another option chosen").
plan.printCompare: Print the options side by side
plan.cancelHint: Services not started are cancelled; work done stays in the record.
plan.alternativesHint: The patient chooses one; you can print the costs side by side.
plan.noItems: This plan has no services yet; add them from the dental chart.
plan.catalogPrice: Catalog price {price}; can be changed for this patient.
plan.noCatalogPrice: This service has no catalog price.
plan.sessionsHint: From the catalog; changeable for this patient.
plan.detailsHint: e.g. implant brand and size, bracket type
plan.validDaysHint: The validity date is printed under the estimate.
plan.estimateFrozen: The estimate is kept with its number (TP-…) in the patient's documents and reprints exactly as today.
settings.toothNumbering.fdiHint: International standard ISO 3950: first digit the quadrant (1–4, baby 5–8), second the tooth; e.g. 36 = lower left first molar.
settings.toothNumbering.universalHint: 1–32 from the upper right wisdom tooth; baby teeth A–T.
settings.toothNumbering.palmerHint: 1–8 in each quadrant with a corner mark; baby teeth A–E. Stored as FDI either way.
settings.toothNumbering.quadrantHint: Each quadrant counts 1–8 from the midline, baby teeth in Roman numerals I–V (Zsigmondy); on the chart the position gives the quadrant, in text a corner mark, e.g. ┌6. Stored as FDI either way.
timeline.subtitle: Everything about the patient in time order, newest first.
treatments.subtitle: Treatments done and under way; each completed one is ready for an invoice (Phase 6).
treatments.invoiceHint: Invoices and payments come in the next version (Phase 6)
treatments.noneHint: Record a treatment on the dental chart ("Done today") or by completing a session's visit.
rule.tooth_surface: Choose the tooth surfaces (M, O, D, B, L).
rule.dentition_slots: A baby tooth only takes the place of teeth 1–5 of a quadrant.
rule.condition_not_found: This tooth condition was not found or is switched off.
rule.plan_not_editable: This plan is closed (completed or cancelled).
rule.plan_has_work_in_progress: Finish or cancel this plan's treatments under way first.
rule.item_not_editable: This treatment is finished or cancelled.
rule.item_teeth: Choose the teeth for this service.
rule.session_number: Every session of this treatment is done or booked (or the session number is wrong).
rule.note_signed: A signed note does not change; write an addendum.
rule.note_empty: Write at least one part of the note.
rule.note_template_not_found: This ready-made note was not found.
rule.plan_template_not_found: This ready-made plan was not found.
rule.perio_value: Not a valid value (depth 0–15, recession −5–15, mobility and furcation 0–3).
billing.subtitle: Invoices, payments, the cash desk, debtors and clinic expenses
billing.invoices.hint: Every invoice of the clinic; click a row for its details.
billing.invoices.search: Invoice number, patient name or number
billing.reason.hint: The reason is kept in the history and cannot be changed later.
billing.settings.receipt.hint: The text at the foot of a receipt is the clinic's; the printer and paper are this computer's.
billing.settings.footer.hint: For example «Thank you». Leave empty to print nothing.
billing.settings.methods.hint: Cash and bank transfer are always there; add others (card, exchange office…).
billing.settings.categories.hint: For the profit report: rent, salaries, electricity, materials and so on.
billing.settings.commission.hint: Leave it off if your clinic pays no commission.
comm.basis.payment.hint: Commission on the money received from the patient (refunds are taken off).
comm.basis.treatment.hint: Commission on the net of treatments invoiced, whether or not paid yet.
comm.title: Doctor commission settlement
comm.off: Commission is off; turn it on in the billing settings.
comm.noneHint: Set a commission rule and have the doctor on the invoice line.
comm.rule.hint: The most specific rule wins: doctor and service, then doctor, then service, then everyone.
comm.rule.fixedHint: In afghani, per unit of treatment
comm.rule.none: No rule yet; with no rule the commission is zero.
expenses.hint: Rent, salaries, electricity, materials and so on, for the profit report.
expenses.fromCash: Paid from the cash drawer (counted when closing)
method.isCash: Is cash, counted when closing the drawer
cash.close.hint: Count the cash in the drawer and enter it; it is compared with what was expected.
cash.staleAfterClose: A payment or refund was recorded after closing.
cash.diff.none: The count matches what was expected.
cash.reason.hint: Required when the count differs from what was expected.
inst.title: Installments
inst.sum.ok: The installments add up to what is owed.
inst.sum.mismatch: The installments add up to {sum} but {n} is owed.
inst.noneHint: Installments that are due soon or late appear here so you can remind the patient.
inv.title: Invoice
inv.subtitle: Each invoice is made from treatments done and cannot be edited once issued.
inv.noneHint: After a treatment is done, make its invoice with one click.
inv.unbilled: {n} treatments done are not invoiced yet (total {total}).
inv.noneReady: No treatment done is waiting. You can add another line.
inv.priceNeedsPermission: Changing a price needs a special permission
inv.discount.hint: The discount in afghani, at most the total.
inv.creditNote.hint: Lowers the invoice after it was issued; at most what is still owed.
inv.void.hint: The treatments become ready to invoice again. Refund an invoice that holds payments first.
inv.finalNote: Once issued an invoice does not change; corrections are a void or a credit note, with a reason.
pay.for.hint: An open invoice, or an advance that becomes the patient's credit.
pay.amount.hintInvoice: This invoice owes {n}; a part payment is fine.
pay.amount.hintAdvance: In afghani; it becomes credit for later invoices.
pay.refund.hint: Gives money back and the invoice owes that much again.
refund.toCredit: Return it as credit instead of money
pay.noneHint: This patient's payments and receipts appear here.
pay.subtitle: Every payment has a numbered receipt; reprinting never records a new payment.
stmt.title: Patient statement
rcpt.reprintNote: This receipt was printed {n} times; the next one says COPY and records no payment.
rcpt.setup.hint: This choice is for this computer; the receipt stays small and standard whatever the printer.
rcpt.setup.printerHint: A thermal or ordinary printer; with none, PDF only.
rcpt.setup.offsetHint: For a printer that prints slightly off (mm).
rcpt.settings.title: Receipt printing on this computer
rcpt.pdfOnlyMode: This computer gives receipts as PDF only; see the printing setup.
rcpt.mode.a6.hint: From an ordinary printer's manual tray
rcpt.mode.a5.hint: From an ordinary printer's manual tray
rcpt.mode.custom.hint: Type your own width and height
rcpt.mode.a4_one.hint: At the top of the sheet, real size
rcpt.mode.a4_two.hint: With a cut line, saves paper
rcpt.mode.a4_four.hint: With cut lines, saves the most paper
rcpt.mode.pdf.hint: No printer; the file is kept in a year and month folder
rule.billing_amount: Not a valid amount; write a number above zero.
rule.amount_too_high: The amount is above the maximum.
rule.payment_method_name: The payment method name is not valid.
rule.invoice_empty: An invoice needs at least one line.
rule.invoice_has_payments: This invoice holds payments; refund them first.
rule.item_not_billable: This treatment cannot be invoiced (not done, or another patient's).
rule.discount_range: The discount is more than the total.
rule.payment_exceeds: More than the invoice owes; record the rest as an advance.
rule.refund_exceeds: More than what is left of that payment.
rule.insufficient_credit: The patient has less credit than that.
rule.installments_invalid: The installments must add up exactly to what is owed.
rule.credit_note_exceeds: A credit note cannot exceed what is still owed.
rule.cash_day_closed: The cash desk of that day is closed.
rule.cash_reason_required: A difference from the expected amount needs a reason.
rule.commission_value: The commission value is out of range (percent up to 100).
rule.period_range: The end is before the start.
error.server_unreachable: The clinic server computer cannot be reached.
lan.title: Network
lan.subtitle: Use Artaveo on several computers in the clinic: one computer is the clinic server, the others connect to it.
lan.server.title: Clinic server
lan.server.hint: Turn this on at the computer that holds the clinic's data. The other computers connect to it; nothing needs to be set up in Windows or on the router.
lan.server.switch: This computer is the clinic server
lan.status.label: Server
lan.computers.label: Connected computers
lan.computers.title: Computers
lan.computers.hint: The computers that may use this clinic's data. Remove the access of a computer that is lost or replaced.
lan.addressHint: Computers find the server by themselves. Type this address only if they cannot.
lan.fingerprintHint: Identifies this server. It stays the same when the server is moved to another computer with a backup.
lan.networkHint: If other computers cannot find the server: set this computer's network to Private in Windows, and check that the router does not keep Wi-Fi devices apart from each other.
lan.limitReached: The plan allows {n} computers besides the server. Remove the access of one to add another.
lan.pairing.title: Pairing code
lan.pairing.valid: Valid for about {m} more minutes · {n} attempts left
lan.pairing.how: On the new computer, choose “Connect to a clinic server” and type this code.
lan.device.name: Computer
lan.devices.empty: No computer has been added yet.
lan.devices.emptyHint: Press “Add a computer” and type the code on the new computer.
lan.background.title: Running in the background
lan.background.hint: Closing the window does not stop the server: it keeps running next to the clock in the taskbar, so the other computers stay connected. Use Quit in that icon's menu to stop it.
lan.autostart: Start Artaveo Dental when Windows starts
lan.revoke.title: Remove the access of “{name}”?
lan.revoke.body: That computer is disconnected at once and can no longer open the clinic's data. It can be added again with a new code.
lan.off.title: Turn off the clinic server?
lan.off.body: {n} computer(s) are connected right now. They are disconnected until the server is turned on again.
lan.client.title: This computer is connected to a clinic server
lan.client.hint: All data is kept on “{name}”. This computer shows it and sends changes there.
lan.client.disconnectBody: The clinic's data stays on the server. This computer will ask for a new connection code before it can be used again.
connect.title: Connect to a clinic server
connect.hint: Use the clinic's data from another computer. On the server, open Settings › Network and press “Add a computer” to get a 6-digit code.
connect.none: No server was found automatically. Check that the server computer is on and in the same network, or type its address.
connect.addressHint: Shown on the server in Settings › Network, for example 192.168.1.10
connect.codeHint: Shown on the server after pressing “Add a computer”.
connect.deviceNameHint: For example Reception or Doctor 1. It appears in the server's list of computers.
connect.pick: Choose a server from the list or type its address.
connect.error.wrong_code: The code is not correct. {n} attempts left.
connect.error.closed: The server is not waiting for a new computer. On the server press “Add a computer” and try again.
connect.error.limit_reached: The number of computers allowed by the clinic's plan is reached.
connect.error.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check that it is on and in the same network.
connect.error.not_authentic: The server could not prove it is the right one. Try again.
connect.error.already_set_up: This computer already has a clinic of its own.
conn.offline.title: The clinic server computer is not on.
conn.offline.body: Nothing is lost. This screen connects again by itself as soon as it is on.
conn.back: Connected to the clinic server again.
conn.revoked.title: This computer's access was removed.
conn.revoked.body: Ask the clinic owner to add it again.
presence.alsoOpen: {names} has this record open too. Save carefully so changes do not overwrite each other.
perm.inventory.view: View stock, suppliers and lab cases
inventory.subtitle: Stock of materials, purchases, suppliers and dental lab work
stock.title: Items and stock
stock.hint: Every item with what is on the shelf, its minimum and expiry; expired stock is never used.
stock.noneHint: Add the clinic's materials to keep track of stock, shortages and expiry.
stock.none.filteredHint: Change the search or the filter.
stock.item.name: Item name
stock.item.minHint: A low-stock warning shows when stock reaches this.
stock.unitCostHint: What one unit cost; the value of the stock is worked out from it.
stock.history.none: No movement in the last 90 days.
stock.receive.title: Receive stock
stock.receive.hint: For opening stock or goods that came without a purchase; use Purchases for a purchase.
stock.consume.title: Take out of stock
stock.consume.fefo: The batch that expires first is used first; expired batches are never used.
stock.adjust.title: Adjust stock
stock.adjust.reasonHint: A reason is required, e.g. “count”, “broken”, “thrown away, expired”.
stock.transfer.title: Move to another place
stock.return.title: Return to supplier
stock.return.creditHint: What the supplier takes off the clinic's debt.
purchase.hint: Each purchase adds its goods to stock and to what is owed the supplier. A recorded purchase is never edited; a mistake is voided.
purchase.newHint: List what was bought with price, lot and expiry.
purchase.paidHint: If paid on the spot; recorded as a payment to the supplier and a clinic expense.
purchase.noneHint: Record every purchase from a supplier here.
purchase.voidHint: Its goods leave stock. If part was used or moved, it cannot be voided.
supplier.hint: Who you buy from or send lab work to, and what the clinic owes each.
supplier.name: Name
supplier.pay.expenseHint: This payment is also recorded as a clinic expense; a cash payment counts in that day's cash closing.
supplier.noneHint: Add a supplier or a lab.
labcase.hint: From the day work goes to the lab to the day it is fitted.
labcase.workHint: For example PFM crown, bridge, denture.
labcase.noLabs: First add a lab under “Suppliers & labs”.
labcase.teethHint: FDI numbers with a space or comma, e.g. 36, 37.
labcase.costHint: An estimate; enter the final cost when the work comes back.
labcase.lateText: {n} case(s) are past their expected date and have not come back.
labcase.treatmentHint: If linked, the lab cost appears beside that treatment's price in the report.
labcase.reportHint: Work that came back in this period, with what its treatment was invoiced for.
labcase.report.none: No work came back from a lab in this period.
invset.categories.hint: To group items in the list.
invset.locations.hint: Main store, treatment room and so on; stock can be moved between them.
invset.name: Name
invset.materials.hint: Optional; if a service has materials, they can all be taken out of stock in one step after the treatment.
invset.materials.none: No materials set for this service
invset.permHint: Seeing stock needs the “view” permission and managing it the “manage” one; set them per role under Users.
rule.stock_quantity: Not a valid quantity; enter a number above zero.
rule.stock_insufficient: There is not that much usable stock.
rule.stock_same_place: The stock is already in this place.
rule.supplier_not_found: This supplier or lab was not found.
rule.purchase_empty: A purchase needs at least one line.
rule.purchase_used: Part of this purchase was used or moved; adjust the stock instead of voiding.
rule.lab_case_not_found: This lab case was not found.
rule.lab_status_invalid: The case cannot change to that status.
rule.lab_case_closed: This case is closed and cannot be edited.
rule.materials_none: This service has no materials set.
rule.materials_already_consumed: This treatment's materials were already taken from stock.
treatments.materialsTaken: This treatment's materials were taken from stock.
